Daily Devotional

November 27

10 He that is faithful in that which is least is faithful also in much: and he that is unjust in the least is unjust also in much. (Luke 16:10 KJV)

Jesus is speaking of our giving of money, tithes and offerings, and He is telling us that doing that is the least that we can do. If we do not trust the promises of God that if we give it will be given back to us (Luke 6:38), then how can we trust God to save us and answer our prayers? If we don’t give to the Kingdom, then we are showing that we don’t trust the Word of God. This not only applies to the giving of money, but also the giving of our time and attention, as well as our love. Anytime we give of our possessions or ourselves, then we are planting a seed in the Kingdom, and it will grow and produce a crop at harvest time. Everything in the world, as well as the Kingdom of God, works on the principal of sowing, time, and harvest (Matthew 13:19-23). People know this is true when planting crops, but many do not believe this when it comes to giving of our money in tithes and offerings. We need to truly have faith in what the Word says, as faith is what pleases God (Hebrews 11:6).

So many times Christians think that they can not afford to give to God, but are going to wait until they have extra to give. This is foolish, as when you are in need that is when you need to give the most, so that you will get the increase that God promises. The bible makes it clear that we are to give money to support the church (Matthew 10:10), and if you do not do so, then how can you believe God for your salvation and other needs? Trust God, and do that, which is least, so that you can prosper in this life as well as forever. You should be sure and give to where you are fed the true Word of God, and not to a dead church. Many people give to their local church, just because they attend it, and not because they receive the spiritual benefit they need. You should give where you are being blessed by the revelation of the Word, so that the Kingdom of God will prosper. Praise God for His Word!

Devotional by Pastor Joe W. Green, www.Infinite-Faith.com
